newsitem.title: UK: Argentine minister - May jobless likely to be 16.2%.
newsitem.headline: Argentine minister - May jobless likely to be 16.2%.

text.p: Argentine economy minister Roque Fernandez said on Thursday the country's preliminary unemployment rate was likely to be 16.2 percent in May, down from latest semi-annual figures showing 17.3 percent in October 1996.

Fernandez, speaking at a news conference in London, told reporters a planned $750 million bond issue, which was delayed on Wednesday, could be placed as early as next week. He also said there were no plans for a buyback of Brady bonds at the present time.
"I believe...the figures will be reporting a number for unemployment in the order of 16.2 percent," Fernandez said.

Fernandez said the expected drop in the unemployment rate was the result of strong economic growth. He said preliminary estimates for second quarter gross domestic product had showed eight percent growth.
Regarding the delayed bond issue, he said: "We are rescheduling operations (for the bond). It could be maybe next week."
He added, "We are not planning to do anything for the time being with respect to buybacks."
